description: This Java source file defines the TaxwareServices class, which provides service methods for calculating taxes and verifying zip codes in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to process tax calculations based on order details and interacts with Taxware utility classes.

classes.name: TaxwareServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for tax calculation and zip code verification within the OFBiz framework using Taxware integration.

methods.name: calcTax
